answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 13748 Country: India Title: Making "Wuzu" in standing position is allowed or not? Question: Making "Wuzu" in standing position is allowed or not? Answer ID: 13748 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 986/835=D/1430) The wudhu is valid if performed standing, but it is better to perform it sitting at raised place facing the qiblah: ومن الآداب أن یجلس المتوضي مستقبل القبلۃ عند غسل سائر الأعضاء وأن یکون جلوسہ علی مکان مرتفع (کبیری Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
